g.text: Cross-Layer Traversal: One User Story Through Four Layers
The Impact Analysis Agent surfaces the full blast radius before any code is written.
"Let users choose how often they receive email alerts for each saved search: daily, weekly, or off."
Impact Analysis Agent traverses the four-layer graph
One database column already exists and supports the change.
No DDL required. No migration. Zero schema risk surfaces in the
impact report before a single line of code is written.
Each row links the Functional outcome, the Design component,
the Architecture service, and the Code module that implements it.
The senior developer who used to assemble this context manually now reviews it.
